cands.name: Daniel Cicirelli
cands.bio: Democrat, 29. Small-business owner and handyman; former design consultant for life-safety systems at Johnson Controls. Founded the Space Coast Self Defense Club; Brevard Democrats precinct organizer. First campaign.
cands.local_ties: Born in Rockledge in 1997 and has lived in Brevard County since; rebuilding in North Brevard after losing his home in 2024; volunteers in Cocoa (campaign site).

record.text: First campaign; no prior office. Supports home rule and repeal of SB 180, insurance rate caps and voucher accountability.

endorsements.text: Engage, Y'all PAC; Democratic Environmental Caucus of Florida; Democratic Veterans Caucus of Florida; International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers (listed on his site).

cands.gaps: Donors not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

cands.name: Matt Woodside
cands.bio: Republican, 44. Educator, coach and athletic director in Brevard Public Schools since 2006. Won the crowded Aug. 2026 primary with 32.4% despite being outspent. NRA lifetime member; supports constitutional carry, school choice and teacher pay.
cands.local_ties: Merritt Island; born 1982 in Rockledge; Merritt Island High School 2000 (campaign site).

record.text: Won the HD 31 Republican primary over Robyn Hattaway (29.9%), Marcus Herman and Mindy Gibson; was the only Republican without an affiliated political committee.

endorsements.text: Brevard School Board member Megan Wright and talk-radio host Bill Mick endorsed him in the primary.

cands.gaps: Florida Politics says "35 years" in Brevard schools, which conflicts with his site (since 2006); site figure used. General-election donors not found.
